reviews.text:
I’ve tried other apps like my fitness pal and even CalAI, and this one is much better than both, because it makes identifying ingredients really easy with the camera feature, and editing weights and ingredients is much smoother on this app than the others. 

I was able to recompose my body with smart tracking with apps like these and weightlifting.

reviews.text: Honestly had zero clue how many calories I was actually eating per day. Also hated having to manually track everything.  This app is super low-effort and keeps me on track.  Big fan.

reviews.title: Has helped me soooooo much
reviews.text: This app is fantastic. It has helped me so much in watching what and how I’m eating. I always hating counting calories, was why I stopped most diets that usually worked but with Caloria it helped me monitor my food, kept me on track and I lost a ton of weight. For anyone who never liked counting calories this is the perfect app for you bc it does the work.
